title: Chapter 445 High-Profile Debut
content:
Chapter 445 High-Profile Debut

At the end, Ying Wuzhi, who was extremely reluctant, cursed and headed towards the direction of the Huangcheng Square.

"Tsk, isn't it just a battle power list? It's no big deal."

Shadow walked on the street without a trace, dressed in a very ordinary and wide robe covering most of his body, and it was impossible to tell that he was a member of the Shadow tribe.

At this moment, the dark eyes were full of dazzling colors, "This time I should try to be as low-key as possible. Of course, the most important thing is to save your life. After all, I have never fought with anyone."

As the younger generation of the Shadow Clan, due to the Shadow Clan's work style and characteristics, most of the Shadow Clan's members are not good at fighting, so Ying Wuzhi has no understanding of his combat ability.

In addition, he is in a peaceful and stress-free place like the deserted city, Ying Wuzhi feels that he is no different from a waste.

Can he really be named on the list like this?

After being silent for a long time, Shadow sighed heavily, then he raised his heavy feet with difficulty and walked towards the Huangcheng Square.

"I can only take one step at a time."

......

"Shadow Master."

"who!"

Just as Ying Wuzong had just stepped to the entrance of the square and had not entered, a hand suddenly patted his shoulder without any warning. This sudden movement made Ying Wuzong's face pale, and in an instant Lost a moment.

At this time, the words of mercy had already jumped into his throat, but the next moment, a gentle voice came into his ears.

"Young Master Ying, don't be nervous. I'm sent by Miss Lu Xue to guide you."

"What?"

Hearing the sound coming from behind, Ying Wuzhi was stunned for a while before turning around.

I saw a young man wearing Huangwei clothes looking at him with a smile.

"Young Master Ying, I heard you are going to make the list. I wonder if you are going to make the list of combat power or the list of geniuses?" The young man from Huangwei looked at Ying Wujie and said softly again.

"Fighting Power List, haha, do you think it's okay to use my strength to fight the combat power list?" Ying Wuzhi's face turned cold, and he was already disliked when he looked at the Huang Wei in front of him.

If it weren't for the Huangwei sent by Miss Lu Xue, she would have already sweared.

As for the guidance I said, Ying Wuzhi knew very well, and it was just to supervise myself.

"Oh, I don't know whether this is a blessing or a disaster."

Ying Wuzhi sighed in his heart. Seeing that Lu Xue was so concerned about him, he had already vaguely guessed that the near-term battle would inevitably cause heavy bleeding.

A peaceful life no longer exists.

Even a bastard like himself was driven out of the bed.

I am just a weak little supreme!

Why force me so much?

With a nervous mood, he officially entered the square of the deserted city without a trace.

Looking at the crowded and lively scenes in the square, Ying Wuzhi was delighted. She liked such a chaotic scene, which was conducive to hiding herself. Then Ying Wuzhi had to get used to finding an inconspicuous place. Observe the situation first.

At this time, many eyes were already looking at him, and he didn't want to attract attention.

Just as Ying Wuzhi pulled his robe, covering half of his cheek, ready to slip away, the young man from the wild guard stood there and shouted suddenly: "The young master of the Shadow Clan, Ying Wuzhi, came to attack the genius list, All the idle people are getting out of here!”

The loud shouts mixed with the power of the law quickly spread throughout the wasteland city square.

After a breath, the entire Huangcheng Square became quiet.

Immediately afterwards, Wan Wan'an eyes looked at Ying Wuzhi.

The huge pressure suddenly drowned out without a trace.

"I, this, I'm cheating!!!"

Shadowless roared in his heart.

At this time, everyone had already begun to look at the shadow without a trace and talk.

Wu Hui, the head of the Human Emperor Palace, has entered the combat power list. Mo Chou stayed in the place where the human race's strong men gathered and looked at the shadowless, murmured, "Shadow Clan? Unexpectedly, there will be someone in the Shadow Clan this time. Come and make the list."

Among the human race, the other strong men nodded one after another. Shi Zhong stroked his beard and narrowed his eyes slightly, "With the style of the Shadow Clan, it is indeed a bit surprising that there are people from the clan coming to the list."

And the other tribes do not know as much about the Shadow Clan as the human tribe.

"Oh my God, I almost forgot that there is a race like the Shadow Clan in the Chaos Realm. How many years have passed since they appeared in the eyes of the world."

What's more, the expression of confusion and a look of incredible expression, "Shadow Clan? What kind of race is this? Why have you never heard of it?"

Hearing this, someone immediately laughed and said, "You don't even know about the Shadow Clan. That is one of the strong clans, a terrifying existence that is shoulder to shoulder with the Heavenly Demon Clan and the Holy Spirit Clan."

"It is said that when the human race rose, the shadow tribe leader of that generation had a fierce look. He immediately saw the fierce development of the human race. Then he resolutely led the entire race to join the human race. From then on, he got on the thigh of the deserted city .”

After hearing this incident, the creatures present suddenly opened their mouths, and many people showed envy.

It's still possible. If their patriarch could have such great courage back then, perhaps he could have lived in the deserted city now.

Alas, ancestors, why are you so unsatisfied?

For a moment, curiosity, jealousy, scrutiny, hostility, all kinds of eyes were mixed together, all falling on the body without a trace.

At this moment, Ying Wuzhi felt bitter inside, but he still forced himself to straighten his body and head towards the direction of the genius list.

Since you can't be low-key, it's hard to be high-key once.

After all, he is also a member of the Shadow Clan. This time he will fight on behalf of the Shadow Clan.

Suddenly, a strange feeling arose from the bottom of my heart.

I don’t know that Shadowless is not known. This is the sense of racial honor, an existence that a shadow clan has never had before.

Looking at Ying Wuzhi's appearance, Mo Chou nodded slightly, "I really didn't expect that even the Shadow Clan would cultivate geniuses in secret. I wonder if the Shadow Clan would create any surprises this time."

As the shadows came to the area of the Tianjiao List without a trace, countless geniuses present suddenly felt an invisible pressure.

"Is that the young master of the Shadow Clan?"

Bai Ling looked at Ying Wujie at the first time. She had only heard of the Shadow Clan a few times in Lu Xue's mouth, and knew very little about the Shadow Clan.

She was a little confused at first. This time, she was born on the double list, why didn’t a member of the Shadow Clan appear?

She also thought that the Shadow Clan was the kind of existence that ignored the world and collapsed in front of her and did not change her color.

And now, the Shadow Clan really can't help it.

"Huh, is this the genius list? I don't know how much I can rank?"

The shadow came to the Tianjiao List without a trace, looking at the ranking on the Tianjiao List.
